ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Four identical pieces of paper are placed as shown. Michael wants to punch a hole that goes through all four pieces. At which point should Michael punch the hole?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are four identical light-blue sheets of paper, all squares whose sides are parallel to the horizontal/vertical directions of the image, and they are placed staggered with respect to each other. The visible boundaries show the complete left-right and upper-lower extents of each sheet: the left rear sheet extends to the left, the right rear sheet extends to the upper right, the middle sheet covers in front of them, and the frontmost sheet extends downward. Among the five candidate points, A and B are in the higher row, and C, D, E are in the lower row. Reasoning: To make one hole pass through four sheets of paper, the punching point must be located in the common overlapping region of the four sheets. The left boundary of the common region is determined by the rightmost left edge, the right boundary is determined by the leftmost right edge, the upper boundary is determined by the lowest upper edge, and the lower boundary is determined by the highest lower edge. Observing the candidate points, A and B are above the upper edge of the frontmost sheet, so they are too high; C is outside the left boundary of the common overlapping region; E is outside the right boundary of the common overlapping region; only D simultaneously falls inside the common overlapping region of the four sheets. Therefore D should be chosen.

raw_record.question_text: Four identical pieces of paper are placed as shown. Michael wants to punch a hole that goes through all four pieces. Which labeled point should he punch?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as four identical, axis-aligned square papers whose visible outlines indicate their full boundaries even where covered. From the image, note each sheet's left/right/top/bottom limits, then form the common overlap region by taking the rightmost left edge, leftmost right edge, lowest top edge, and highest bottom edge. The text says the hole must go through all four pieces, so the punch point must lie inside this intersection. Checking the labeled dots A–E against that common rectangle, only point D lies within all four papers; A and B are too high, C is too far left, and E is too far right.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有四张相同的浅蓝色纸，都是边与画面水平/竖直方向平行的正方形，并且互相错开放置。可见的边界显示每张纸的完整左右上下范围：左后方纸向左伸出，右后方纸向右上方伸出，中间纸覆盖在它们前面，最前面的纸向下方伸出。五个候选点中，A、B在较高的一排，C、D、E在较低的一排。推理：要让一个洞穿过四张纸，打孔点必须位于四张纸的共同重叠区域。共同区域的左边界由最靠右的左边缘决定，右边界由最靠左的右边缘决定，上边界由最低的上边缘决定，下边界由最高的下边缘决定。观察候选点，A和B位于最前面纸的上边缘之上，因此太高；C在共同重叠区域左边界之外；E在共同重叠区域右边界之外；只有D同时落在四张纸的共同重叠区域内。因此应选择D。

planner_metadata.image_role: Provides the positions and outlines of the four overlapping identical papers and the labeled candidate points A, B, C, D, and E.
planner_metadata.text_role: Specifies that there are four pieces and that the desired punch must pass through all four, establishing the criterion for choosing a point.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule that a single punch through stacked/overlapping sheets passes through every sheet only at points contained in the intersection of all four sheet regions.
